personality_one_liner: A secure, structured, and highly readable environment that turns complex tax documents into calm, trustworthy progress.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical breathing room. Cards never sit flush to edges (always use at least md/lg margin). Clear visual grouping of data points.

do's: Use on the sticky bottom tab bar
Use as a frosted overlay on the featured Hero card (Return Draft Progress) over the textured background
Use on sticky section headers during list scroll (e.g., Document Vault)
dont's: Never use on dense data rows, form fields, or standard list items
Never use for error/warning states (use solid colors instead)

screens.name: Onboarding
screens.purpose: Introduce the secure AI tax agent and establish trust before authentication.

states.error: Error toast on failed auth with retry.

screens.layout: Full-bleed imagery on the top half with a gradient scrim fading to surface color. The bottom half contains Plus Jakarta Sans display text, subtext, and sticky Google/Email auth buttons wrapped in safe area.

screens.name: Dashboard
screens.purpose: Provide a high-level overview of the current tax year status and actionable tasks.

states.loading: Skeleton loader for the hero card and quick action widgets
states.empty: No tax year started: Show a welcome illustration and a primary 'Start Return' CTA.
states.error: Unable to load dashboard data: Clear readable message with a 'Retry' button.

screens.layout: Modular vertical layout. Top area features a large, glass-overlay hero card over an abstract textured background, displaying the 'Return Draft Builder' 7-step pipeline progress. Below the hero card, a 2-column grid (flexWrap: wrap, space-between) for quick actions (Upload Doc, Review Queue). Bottom section contains a vertical list of recently scanned documents.

screens.name: Document Vault
screens.purpose: List and categorize all uploaded and AI-classified tax documents (W-2, 1099, etc.).

states.empty: Secure vault illustration with 'No documents uploaded yet.' and a primary 'Scan Document' CTA.
states.error: Failed to load documents: Readable error + Retry button.

screens.layout: Sticky glass header with search/filter tabs. Content is a comfortable vertical list. Each row includes a tinted icon container (brandTertiary), document title, extraction confidence badge (green/yellow chip), and chevron. Use generous padding (16pt) per row.

screens.name: AI Extraction Detail
screens.purpose: Show the raw document alongside the AI-extracted fields, allowing human verification.

states.error: Failed to load extraction data: Readable error + Retry button.

screens.layout: Split or scrollable view: Top section shows a thumbnail/preview of the document. Bottom section is a clean form-like list of extracted key-value pairs (e.g., Box 1: Wages) with confidence scores next to them. If a field has low confidence, it's highlighted with a warning surface. A sticky CTA at the bottom allows the user to 'Confirm' or 'Edit'.

screens.name: Review Queue
screens.purpose: Human-in-the-loop interface to resolve items the AI flagged as risky or missing.

states.empty: Minimalist desk illustration with 'All caught up! No items need your review.'
states.error: Failed to load queue: Readable error + Retry.

screens.layout: Card-based swipeable or sequential stepper layout. One flagged item per screen to focus attention, detailing the discrepancy (e.g., 'Missing 1099-INT based on prior year'). Sticky action buttons at the bottom: 'Skip', 'Upload Missing', or 'Acknowledge'.

hero_card_bg.alt: Abstract flowing curves in shades of light mint green

empty_review.alt: Empty minimalist desk representing no pending review tasks

empty_vault.alt: Secure vault lock symbolizing data privacy

onboarding_1.alt: Clean minimalist office desk setup representing streamlined tax processing

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the color palette. Do NOT use any blue, indigo, or purple. The app relies on a trust-building Sage Green (#3D5A46) and Warm Sand (#F7F6F2) palette.
Enforce iOS-Native Clean spacing: use generous padding around cards and avoid dense, cramped lists. The AI extraction detail screen should feel like a calm form, not a cluttered spreadsheet.
Implement glassmorphism on the main hero card on the Dashboard, overlaying the abstract sage green texture background for a premium fintech feel.
Ensure every screen implements the defined empty, loading, and error states. Do not leave empty states as blank screens.
For the Document Vault list, use tinted icon containers (brandTertiary background with brandPrimary icon) for each list item to provide immediate visual structure.

All confidence scores (e.g., 'Box 1 Wages 99%') should be displayed using small pill/chip components with appropriate semantic status colors (success, warning, error) to quickly draw human attention to low-confidence extractions.
Primary call-to-action buttons (like 'Start Return' or 'Upload Missing') must stick to the bottom of the screen (above the safe area/home indicator), separate from the scrollable content.
